platform: Shopify, theme 'Impact' 3.1.1 (Maestrooo) customised by Jumpstart ('[Main] Sojao x Jumpstart')

heading.family: Poynter Oldstyle Display (Regular, Type Network webfont; theme var still says Cormorant 500 but Poynter wins)

fonts.hero_and_banner_subhead_fallback: Arial-like sans (bold subline in 'We Hustle Hard / Just like you' and 'Better Sleep / for everyone')

colors.accent_navy: #29378C rgb(41,55,140) (headings, nav text, primary button, links)
colors.rust: #BA5028 rgb(186,80,40) (announcement text, mega-menu column titles, NEW/sale badge, journal hero bg, footer 'Sleep Easy Club')
colors.button_secondary: white bg / navy text / navy 1px border

motion.slideshow: 3 slides, fade_with_text, autoplay attr 20 (sampled ~15s per slide), background mp4 videos
